what_it_is.prose: Walchandnagar Industries Limited (WIL) is a heavy engineering products and EPC services company headquartered in Pune, founded on 25 November 1908 by Seth Walchand Hirachand Doshi. Operates in Defence, Nuclear & Aerospace (DNAM) and Industrial Products (Gears, Centrifugals, Castings, Gauges) plus EPC of sugar mills. ISRO partnership began 1973 with supply of flight hardware for SLV-3, extended to all subsequent launch vehicle programmes (ASLV, PSLV, GSLV, LVM3). Manufactures booster motor casings and nozzles for ISRO space programmes; key role in Chandrayaan-3 mission (Aug 2023). Latest ₹30.53 Cr order from ISRO's Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (Aug 2026) for rocket booster hardware. Defence: Agni missile components, airborne launchers, BrahMos missile components. Nuclear: critical equipment for India's first indigenous nuclear submarine (Arihant-class SSBN) and PFBR.
